title: Civil Maintenance to the Lighthouse tower and compound wall of Cuddalore Lighthouse Station.
summary: E-tender (percentage rate, two-cover) for civil maintenance of the lighthouse tower and compound wall at Cuddalore Lighthouse, Cuddalore Port, Tamil Nadu (Chennai Directorate); bid deadline later extended to 07.10.2025.

procurement.reference: DW-CHE-01001(07)/1/2021-Civil Maintenance; DW-CHE-01001(07)/1/2020-Civil Maintenance (corrigendum); Tender ID 2025_DGLL_876449_1
procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

sites.name: Cuddalore Lighthouse Station, Cuddalore Port, Cuddalore District, Tamilnadu
sites.work: Civil maintenance to lighthouse tower and compound wall

scope.item: Civil Maintenance to the Lighthouse tower and compound wall

money.notes: Estimated cost including 18% GST. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled/nationalised bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai, payable at Chennai; validity printed as three months (table) and 90 days (clause 1.1) from technical bid opening; exempted for valid MSME/NSIC certificate. Tender fee Nil.

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category & class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous bodies

Similar works in last seven years: three each >= 40%, two each >= 50%, or one >= 80% of estimated cost; only completed works with completion certificate; value updated at 7% simple per annum; certificates below Executive Engineer rank not considered
Similar works: repairs and civil maintenance of building or construction of any type of building/compound wall/retaining wall/RCC work
Average annual turnover on construction works (CA certified) at least 40% of estimated cost in last 3 financial years ending 31 March 2025
Key technical personnel for supervision and execution with qualification and experience
Unconditional tender undertaking (Annexure III); tender acceptance letter (Annexure II); affidavit/self-attestation of not blacklisted
Declaration of gazetted and non-gazetted relatives serving in MoPSW or DGLL; Make in India self-certification (Annexure VI)

corrigenda.change: Extension of last date: bid document download and online submission extended to 07.10.2025 15:00; bids opened 08.10.2025 15:00 (originally submission 25.09.2025, opening 26.09.2025)
